prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1282; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers remained at scene. Police report requested. Insured's vehicle has visible damage to the right rear quarter panel.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured reports neck stiffness and headache following the impact and says they were evaluated at an urgent care facility. Vehicle assigned to appraiser for inspection and estimate. Liability appears disputed pending review of the other driver's account.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and filed. Request for medical records and billing issued to counsel. Claimant's injury described as whiplash with ongoing neck pain and reduced range of motion.

Entry 4: Appraisal received and reviewed. Repair estimate exceeds the threshold for a total loss evaluation, so the vehicle is being valued for a possible settlement rather than repair. Comparable vehicle valuation requested. Medical records received and under review for treatment timeline and consistency with reported mechanism of injury.

Entry 5: Liability evaluation updated after review of the police report and scene photographs. Evidence supports the other driver changing lanes into the insured's path. Bodily injury claim placed on hold pending receipt of final treatment records and itemized medical bills from counsel. Reserve adjusted. Next follow-up scheduled for review of outstanding documents.
